data.name: Dust
data.detailed_description:
Dust is a first-person survival horror game where one mission stands between a dying city and the peace it hasn't known in years.

You wake up alone in a city torn apart by an outbreak — the streets ruled by the infected, silence broken only by distant screams. A small group of survivors reaches you by radio. They have one plan left: locate four infested zones, mark them, and call in a strike that could end this nightmare for good.

Explore. Mark. Survive. Scavenge a hostile open world for supplies, craft weapons and tools, and build a base to protect everything you've fought to keep. Every infested zone you find brings you one step closer — and one step deeper into danger.

The city is listening. Every gunshot, every scream draws attention. Alert a scout and the whole district turns hostile, hunting you through the dark. Survival here isn't just about strength — it's about staying quiet, staying smart, and knowing when to run.

One shot. No turning back. When all four zones are marked, the city won't let you go without a fight. Hold your base against a final wave of the infected — then make the call that decides everything.

Every decision matters. Every day alive is a victory. And somewhere out there, a voice on the radio is counting on you.
